record.paper_title: Infinity in string cosmology: A review through open problems
record.original_question: When the M-theory action is deformed by higher-order Lovelock and Weyl corrections, are the resulting exact 11-dimensional supergravity cosmological solutions stable, what asymptotic modes do their fields admit, and can this analysis establish a no-hair theorem for an inflationary stage in M-theory?

evidence.quote:
3.5 Stability of 11-dimensional supergravity cosmology I
The aim of this project is to see whether the properties of M-theory cosmologies studied in other projects above are stable with respect to perturbations formed when the M-theory action contains higher order corrections. ... Are these solutions stable? In this problem one expects to trace all possible asymptotic modes of the ﬁelds, and in this way to give the ﬁrst reliable results about the possibility of a no-hair theorem for an inﬂationary stage in M-theory.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider eleven-dimensional supergravity, whose bosonic field content consists of the metric $g_{MN}$ on an 11-dimensional spacetime $M^{11}$ and a 3-form gauge potential $A_3$ with 4-form field strength $F_4 = dA_3$. The classical bosonic action is
$$S_0 = \frac{1}{2\kappa_{11}^2}\int_{M^{11}} d^{11}x\,\sqrt{-g}\Big(R - \tfrac{1}{2}|F_4|^2\Big) - \frac{1}{12\kappa_{11}^2}\int A_3\wedge F_4\wedge F_4.$$
Deform this action by adding higher-order curvature corrections of Lovelock type (i.e. corrections built from the dimensionally extended Euler densities $\mathcal{L}_k = \frac{1}{2^k}\delta^{M_1 N_1\cdots M_k N_k}_{P_1 Q_1\cdots P_k Q_k}R_{M_1 N_1}{}^{P_1 Q_1}\cdots R_{M_k N_k}{}^{P_k Q_k}$) together with Weyl-curvature corrections (scalar polynomial invariants of the Weyl tensor $C_{MNPQ}$, in particular quartic contractions such as $t_8 t_8 C^4$ and $\epsilon_{11}\epsilon_{11}C^4$), yielding a corrected action
$$S = S_0 + \sum_{k\ge 2}\alpha_k \int d^{11}x\,\sqrt{-g}\,\mathcal{L}_k + \sum_j \beta_j \int d^{11}x\,\sqrt{-g}\,\mathcal{W}_j(C),$$
with fixed real coupling constants $\alpha_k,\beta_j$.

Assume that an exact cosmological solution of $S$ has been chosen with an 11-dimensional product geometry of FRW type (a 4-dimensional homogeneous, isotropic factor with scale factor $a(t)$ and a compact internal manifold of suitable holonomy), supporting a nontrivial $F_4$ flux background.

Address the following:

(a) Linear stability. Determine whether the chosen exact cosmological solution is linearly stable against small perturbations of the metric and the 3-form potential, by deriving the linearised equations of motion for $(\delta g_{MN}, \delta A_3)$ on this background and analysing the spectrum of allowed perturbations.

(b) Asymptotic modes. Classify all asymptotic modes (as $t\to\infty$ in the cosmological time) of the perturbation fields, identifying which modes decay, oscillate, or grow.

(c) No-hair theorem. Using (a) and (b), decide whether an inflationary phase of the 4-dimensional factor (i.e. an epoch in which $a(t)$ undergoes accelerated expansion) is an attractor in the sense of a cosmic no-hair theorem: namely, whether every sufficiently small perturbation of the solution decays so that the late-time geometry approaches the inflationary background, and if so, formulate and prove such a no-hair theorem in this corrected M-theory setting.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent literature studies inflationary cosmology in M-theory with quartic Weyl corrections and explores regularised Lovelock corrections in connection with inflation and no-hair-type results, but no work appears to provide a complete linear-stability analysis of exact 11-dimensional supergravity cosmologies under combined higher-order Lovelock and Weyl corrections together with a proven cosmic no-hair theorem for inflation in M-theory. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Inflationary Cosmology via Quantum Corrections in M-theory
status_evidence.snippet: Considers 11D supergravity with (Weyl)^4 corrections and shows inflation can arise once quantum corrections are included.
status_evidence.claim: The combined corrected M-theory action is actively studied, but stability/no-hair conclusions are not established.

status_evidence.title: Cosmological Perturbations via Quantum Corrections in M-Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Studies cosmological perturbations from Weyl^4 quantum corrections in M-theory.
status_evidence.claim: Perturbative/stability analyses are still being developed and no definitive no-hair theorem for M-theory inflation is reported.

status_evidence.title: Inflation, black holes from an infinite tower of regularized Lovelock-Proca corrections
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) exploration of Lovelock corrections in connection with inflation and hair/no-hair questions.
status_evidence.claim: Lovelock corrections in inflationary cosmology remain a current research direction, indicating the original problem is not settled.
